title: Ash-Shams 91:9-15 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y4 lesson 17 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ash-Shams 91:9-15 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 17. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا (٩) وَقَدْ خَابَ مَن دَسَّىٰهَا (١٠) كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِطَغْوَىٰهَآ (١١) إِذِ ٱنۢبَعَثَ أَشْقَىٰهَا (١٢) فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقْيَٰهَا (١٣) فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَعَقَرُوهَا فَدَمْدَمَ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّهُم بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسَوَّىٰهَا (١٤) وَلَا يَخَافُ عُقْبَٰهَا (١٥)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: He has succeeded who purifies it,
And he has failed who instills it [with corruption].
Thamud denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
And the messenger of Allah [Salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
And He does not fear the consequence thereof.

questions.q: Chunk and link Ash-Shams 91:9-15 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 91:9-15 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 91:9-15 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: Write two ways to 'purify the soul' in daily life.
questions.a: For example: telling the truth; asking Allah's forgiveness; giving charity.

questions.q: Recite all of Ash-Shams (15 ayat), then name the two iqlab examples.
91:9 says the one who succeeds is the one who ...
questions.a: A) purifies the soul. 'He has succeeded who purifies it' (91:9). Riches and strength are not mentioned.

questions.q: Ash-Shams 91:13: «فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: A people were given a clear sign and told to look after it, but they harmed it. What do you think happened?
questions.a: Thamud hamstrung the she-camel of Allah, so their Lord destroyed them (91:11 to 14). Success is for the one who purifies the soul (91:9).
